logical_action.reading: the transversal permutation gates act as logical Clifford operations preserving the O+(10,2) form; because a qubit permutation hits X and Z identically, they are the diagonal CSS gates diag(M,M)

eastin_knill.reading: the transversal gate group is a FINITE subgroup of index 1813217280 in O+(10,2) and far smaller than Sp(10,2): necessarily non-universal (Eastin-Knill) and containing no non-Clifford gate -- the magic is the E6 cubic, supplied outside the permutation group
